Method of Attack: Exploiting flaws in Apache and Apache Spark, targeting vulnerabilities in MiniDVBLinux DVR systems, Grandstream networking systems, and the Roxy-WI GUI, also uses the brute force technique to identify the architecture and employs various persistence mechanisms depending on the operating system
Attack Vector: IoT and web application vulnerabilities, common usernames and passwords for IoT devices over SSH and telnet, port-knocking on specific ports
